 Over the summer, Karl-Anthony Towns and Jordyn Woods got married, which means that the star center got two rings: a wedding band and one for the New York Knicks' championship .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In the fifth slide of her Instagram post from Opening Night, Woods borrowed her husband's championship ring, flaunting it alongside her wedding band.
 It has been a big year for Woods and KAT, who tied the knot after several years of dating. They started seeing each other in 2020. Towns was still on the Minnesota Timberwolves at the time.
 They got engaged on Christmas Day in 2025. Their wedding was held on Aug. 15, 2026, in Malibu, California. Among the guests were Towns' teammates and Knicks superfans like Ben Stiller and Timothée Chalamet. Chalamet's partner, Kylie Jenner, was also there. Justin and Hailey Bieber also made it.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Knicks received their championship rings before their Opening Night game against the Philadelphia 76ers on Tuesday, Oct. 20. They lost, but at least they celebrated their NBA Finals win one last time before turning the page to the 2026-27 season.
 Towns was electric in the loss. He got in foul trouble early, but he ended the game with 19 points, 12 rebounds, and an assist in only 24 minutes. KAT was extremely efficient, making six of nine shots and going 3-for-4 on three-pointers.
 Click Here to Subscribe He is hoping to keep that going for the rest of the season. Last year, he played in 75 games and started all of them. He averaged 20.1 points per game, a big dip from his 24.4 points per game average a year before, but he was playing fewer minutes.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Regardless, it was enough to help the Knicks win a championship. The offense began running through KAT in the postseason, and he averaged almost two more assists per game in the playoffs.
